passive_skill_sets.name: Super Saiyan for Starters
Super Saiyan for Starters
Power Merged with Buu
Miracle Performed in Hell
passive_skill_sets.itemized_description:
*Activates the Entrance Animation starting from the 4th turn from the start of battle upon the character's entry*
- Can Exchange with Super Saiyan Goku (Angel) + Super Saiyan Vegeta (Angel)
*Basic effect(s)*
- Ki +5 and ATK & DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
- {passiveImg:once}DEF 300%{passiveImg:up_g} for 3 turns
- {passiveImg:once}Guards all attacks for 3 turns
- Receives an additional Ki +3 per Rainbow Ki Sphere obtained
- "Successors" Category allies' Ki +1 and DEF 40%{passiveImg:up_g}
- "Fusion" and "Successors" Category allies' Ki +1 and DEF 40%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When attacking*
- ATK 200%{passiveImg:up_g} and DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
*As the 2nd attacker in a turn or as the 3rd attacker in a turn*
- Guards all attacks
- Launches an additional attack that has a great chance of becoming a Super Attack
*When attacking with 10 or more Ki*
- Attacks are effective against all Types
*When attacking with 20 or more Ki*
- Launches an additional Super Attack
